# Test Fixtures

This directory holds test EXR plates used by the unit and integration tests.

## Synthetic fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate_test_ball.py`. Run:

```
python -m scripts.generate_test_ball tests/fixtures/synthetic_ball.exr
```

This produces a 2048x2048 synthetic chrome ball reflecting a known gradient
environment. Used for round-trip and orientation tests.

## Real-world fixtures

To add a real on-set chrome ball plate:

1. Drop the EXR into this directory.
2. The file is gitignored by default (`*.exr` in root `.gitignore`).
3. Reference it via env var or skip the test if missing.
